name: Infrared Line Tracking Sensor
description: Like robot road navigation! Bounces infrared light off the ground to distinguish white roads from black tape.
realWorldAnalogy: Like robot road navigation! Bounces infrared light off the ground to distinguish white roads from black tape.
wiringGuidance: Connect VCC (Red) to 5V, GND (Dark Slate) to GND, and D0 (Green) to digital pin 7.
commonMistakes: Placing sensor too far from ground (optimal focal distance is 3mm to 10mm).
Using shiny reflective tape instead of matte electrical tape.

miniExperiment.title: Dark Line Detector
miniExperiment.circuit: VCC to 5V, GND to GND, D0 to Pin 7.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: Serial Monitor prints 'BLACK LINE DETECTED' when placed over dark tape, and 'White Surface' otherwise.
